description.text:
Japan's Movie Special Pack for the live-action film POKÉMON Detective Pikachu, released on 26 April 2019 ahead of the film. Its 25 cards show the film's Pokémon as the 3D models made by the film's visual effects studios, Moving Picture Company and Framestore, and include Charizard-GX, Greninja-GX, Mewtwo-GX, Detective Pikachu and a Super Rare Lt. Yoshida.

Each pack held three Common cards and one Uncommon or better, all Commons and Uncommons in mirror holofoil, and a box of 20 packs was sure to make a complete set. The English counterpart, Detective Pikachu, has 18 cards and was sold only inside other products.
